import pickle,runpy,numpy as np

def bank(i,j):
  x=z['x'][np.r_[i,j]]; x=(x-x[:len(i)].mean(0))/x[:len(i)].std(0); G=(1+x@x.T/4)**2
  n=len(i); I=np.eye(n); yc=y[i]-y[i].mean(); ans=[]
